about_the_game:
Building thriving island cities in this addictive match-3 deck-building roguelike!

Place forests, mountains, cities, and more on islands using cards from your deck. Match 3 identical features to combine them into a bigger, better structure that scores you points. Can you earn enough to satisfy the King's demands and advance to the next island?

Key Features:

Unique Match-3 Roguelike - Every run offers fresh challenges with randomized rewards and islands

Powerful Policies - Discover game-changing policies that change the rules and transform how you play. Stack synergies and build powerful scoring combinations!

City Building Meets Puzzles - Watch humble settlements grow into bustling metropolises as you cleverly arrange and match your features.

Pick Up and Play - Perfect for quick sessions or longer puzzle marathons. Each run delivers satisfying progression without demanding huge time commitments

Charming Pixel Art - Vibrant, colorful islands come alive with cute buildings and a delightful pixel art aesthetic

Master the perfect balance of strategy and luck as you draft cards, arrange your city, and hunt for those satisfying triple matches. With countless Policy combinations and endless replayability, no two runs are ever the same.
